items.title: Switzerland’s first spot Bitcoin ETF ticks up 0.6% in opening hour
items.description: The spot Bitcoin ETF will be backed by Bitcoin held in cold storage at a Swiss bank, unlike prior Bitcoin ETPs structured as debt securities.

items.title: Spot bitcoin ETFs on track for worst month on record as bear market drags on
items.description: Spot bitcoin ETFs have already hit record monthly net outflows of $5.39 billion in November, with several trading days remaining.

items.title: Europe’s only spot bitcoin ETF starts trading in Switzerland, BIT says
items.description: BIT Asset Management's BBIT fund debuted on SIX Swiss Exchange with 350 BTC in assets and a 0.19% annual expense ratio.

items.title: $7 billion of bitcoin options expire Friday, and the biggest bets look starkly different from October
items.description: Bitcoin options positioning has flipped bearish ahead of Friday’s $7 billion expiry, with traders piling into downside protection as volatility rises.

items.title: Over 1,000 Bitcoin miners were tricked into working for a thief by a fake internet route
items.description: An attacker steered up to 1.9 EH/s of mining power to an impostor pool earlier in November using a weakness most of the industry's largest pools still carry.

items.title: Bill to lock up U.S. government bitcoin for 20 years advances to full House
items.description: A bill to codify Trump’s Strategic Bitcoin Reserve has cleared committee and is eligible for a House vote, but it faces a tight deadline.
